name: What is the typical remodeling process?
description: The typical remodeling process involves consultation, design, permitting, construction, and a final walk-through.

mainEntity.name: What is the typical remodeling process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The remodeling process typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, needs, and budget. This is followed by design and planning, where detailed plans and material selections are made. Next, permits are secured, if required. Construction then commences, involving demolition, framing, utility rough-ins, insulation, drywall, finishes, and fixtures. The project concludes with a final walk-through and punch list to ensure your complete satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: The typical remodeling process involves consultation, design, permitting, construction, and a final walk-through.
